# Top Shelf Business Solutions

> Top Shelf Business Solutions, based in Denton, Texas, sells two things to local businesses across the United States: the Signature plan, which is the Top Shelf CRM, and a professional website. The CRM answers calls with an AI receptionist that books jobs, texts back missed calls, takes online bookings, runs a dispatch board, sends estimates and invoices by text, takes card payments, asks for reviews and replies to them, sends on-my-way texts, and adds an AI chatbot to the customer's current website. The customer's customer list, phone number, website and domain stay in their name; only the CRM software is subscribed.

## Plans and pricing
- [Pricing](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/pricing.html): One plan and one website. The Signature plan is $99 a month for 1 to 10 users and $199 a month for 11 to 25 users; 26 or more users is call for pricing. No setup fee, month to month, no contract. Each phone line (calling and texting from the app, on a ported or new number) is $50 a month per line and covers normal use; usage above that is billed. A professional website is $499 one time and is not part of the Signature plan: a mobile-friendly custom design built by Top Shelf, built so Google can read it, a contact and booking form that feeds the CRM, and a logo if needed. The website is the customer's to keep.
- [Try the CRM](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/contact.html): a short request form, not a login. Top Shelf calls the business, then sends a demo of the CRM.

## What the Signature plan includes
- [CRM and Follow-Up](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-crm.html): contacts, pipeline and follow-up reminders, with estimates, a dispatch board and a customer hub.
- [AI Phone and Chat](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-ai-phone.html): an AI receptionist that answers and books jobs, missed-call text-back, and an AI chatbot added to the customer's current website.
- [Reviews](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-reviews.html): review requests and review replies.
- [Online Booking](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-booking.html): online booking, the dispatch board and on-my-way texts.
- [Payments](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-payments.html): estimates, invoice by text and card payments.
- [AI and Automation](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-automation.html): the AI receptionist, chatbot, missed-call text-back, follow-up reminders and on-my-way texts working on their own.

## Websites
- [Professional websites](https://www.topshelfsolutions.io/solution-websites-seo.html): a $499 one-time website built by Top Shelf. No ongoing SEO service; the site is built so Google can read it.
